name: Tribulation Saints

tenures.note: Splintered from the-asylum-lcw (already registered on the lcw side) once Doctor David Chambers went solo as Evo Champion; entrance line "Nothing Stays Divine Forever" ties the unit back explicitly to Divine Intervention, the-asylum-lcw's own predecessor. Won Impulse 1.9's tag match over Pheonyx/Gryfon by pinfall.

caption: The Asylum's own splinter once Doctor David Chambers went solo — "Nothing Stays Divine Forever," and neither did they.
